notes: Sourced from Luminex's own datasheet PDF (gigacore_specifications_rev3-3.pdf) and the official GigaCore 14R User Manual (rev 2.8.4, section 2.3 "Description" / rear panel breakdown), both hosted on luminex.be -- authoritative and mutually consistent on physical I/O. A separate SKU "GigaCore 14R with PoE" exists with a built-in PoE module (its own PoE status LED); the plain GigaCore 14R modeled here uses an optional external PoE Supply Unit instead. All Ethernet/EtherCon and SFP ports are rated 10/100/1000Mbps (graded eth-1g); switch fabric throughput is 32Gbps non-blocking. Unit is 1U (482 x 204.3 x 44mm / 19" x 8.04" x 1.73"), 2.5kg, metal enclosure, 2 internal redundant fans (not modeled as ports). Reset button and status LEDs also omitted as they are not signal/power connectors.

ports.name: EtherCon 1-10 (Front)
ports.note: 10x shielded Neutrik EtherCon (RJ45) ports on the front panel, numbered 1-10, 10/100/1000Mbps.

ports.name: EtherCon 11-12 (Rear)
ports.note: 2x shielded Neutrik EtherCon (RJ45) ports on the rear panel, continuing the numbering as 11-12, 10/100/1000Mbps.

ports.name: SFP 13-14
ports.note: 2x SFP cages on rear panel accepting Mini-GBIC transceivers, 10/100/1000Mbps. (Note: the manual's SFP-installation section text mentions 'four SFP cages', but this conflicts with both the manufacturer datasheet and the manual's own rear-panel diagram, which both list 2x SFP for the 14R -- that text appears to be copy/paste leftover from the 16Xt manual.)

ports.name: Console
ports.note: RS-232 serial console port on an RJ45-shaped connector, rear panel, labeled 'Console'. No Ethernet bandwidth grade applies (serial, not switched Ethernet).

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: IEC inlet with fuse holder (3.15A 250V slow-blow), 100-240VAC 50-60Hz, rear panel.

ports.name: Redundant Power In (PSU)
ports.note: 15VDC/2A backup power input for the optional Luminex GigaCore RPSU (redundant power supply unit). Physical connector is a proprietary Molex Micro-Fit 6-pin connector, not a true barrel jack -- 'dc-barrel' chosen as closest allowed id.

ports.name: Redundant PoE In
ports.note: 48VDC/2.1A backup PoE input for the optional Luminex GigaCore RPSU. Physical connector is a proprietary Molex Micro-Fit 6-pin connector, not a true barrel jack -- 'dc-barrel' chosen as closest allowed id. Feeds the optional external PoE Supply Unit (LU 01 00051-GC14/16) that injects up to 160W PoE across the 10 front ports; this PoE capability is an add-on module, not a built-in port on the base 14R.
